description: River Murray Flood 2022 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. Boundary showing the extent of land flooded during the 2022/2023 flood event for the River Murray. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are Flood, river murray. It offers 4 resource(s) in geojson, kmz, shp. The portal shows 2024-03-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
